fi|c781ca0e4753f894.en: The Director of Social Services, Health and Rescue decided to accept Stratum Oy's offer for the purchase of dental X-ray services. The decision was made on the basis of a tender and on terms and conditions. The estimated value of the acquisition, free of charge, for the contract period is approximately EUR 700 000, including the period of options.
fi|c781ca0e4753f894.et: Sotsiaalteenuste, tervishoiu ja päästeteenistuse direktor otsustas vastu võtta Stratum Oy pakkumise hamba röntgeniteenuse ostmiseks. Otsus tehti hanke alusel ja tingimustel. Hanke eeldatav tasuta maksumus lepinguperioodil on ligikaudu 700 000 eurot, kaasa arvatud optsioonide periood.
fi|c781ca0e4753f894.lt: Socialinių paslaugų, sveikatos ir gelbėjimo direktorius nusprendė priimti "Stratum Oy" pasiūlymą įsigyti dantų rentgeno paslaugas. fi|c7b039604894862f.en: The authority requests offers for the acquisition of a platform for joint development in accordance with this call for tenders and its documentation, which targets a browser-based cloud computing solution as a platform for joint development within Valtori and to support cooperation with stakeholders.
